technical.summary: Short-term momentum is strong with overbought conditions and exceptional volume spike, but intermediate/long-term trend structure is weak with price below key moving averages and bearish EMA crosses, creating conflicting signals.

fundamental.summary: KO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 112 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (30/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no conviction signal; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (306.7) indicates extreme market stress, though falling DXY provides modest relief for multinational KO; earnings in 112 days poses no immediate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Exceptional 15x volume spike combined with SMA 9/21 golden cross and supertrend bullish signal creates short-term momentum entry, amplified by extreme fear sentiment (30/100) offering contrarian opportunity near support at 51.23.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below SMA 50 and 200, both EMA 20/50 and 50/200 are bearish, CMF and AO are negative, macro environment is severely unfavourable (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, recession risk), and fundamental score is critically weak (3/10) with zero insider/institutional conviction and high earnings risk in 112 days.

decision.entry_rationale: While 15x volume spike and SMA 9/21 golden cross offer short-term momentum, the setup is undermined by price below SMA 50/200, bearish EMA structure, and critically weak fundamentals (score 3/10) with zero institutional conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 306.7, recession signals) combined with negative CMF/AO and earnings binary risk in 112 days creates asymmetric downside despite short-term momentum.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents see momentum but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate winner is bear with medium confidence
